plainTranslation: Their presence and the way they carry themselves press against your direction, ambitions, and public reputation.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their presence and the way they carry themselves press against your direction, ambitions, and public reputation.
summaryDeep: Their presence and the way they carry themselves press against your direction, ambitions, and public reputation. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
